# OpenDock

> Open-source, privacy-first smart dock and widget platform for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Runs locally without a mandatory account; MIT licensed.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://opendock.pages.dev/): Overview, comparison, and real product screenshots
- [Documentation](https://opendock.pages.dev/docs/): Install, download builds, and developer setup
- [GitHub](https://github.com/isaacobenzy/OpenDock): Source, issues, and releases (.exe today; .dmg / Linux packages on roadmap)
- [Roadmap](https://opendock.pages.dev/roadmap/): Cross-platform bundling and widget SDK milestones
- [Feedback](https://opendock.pages.dev/feedback/): Feature requests and bug reports

## Optional

- [Extended agent context](https://opendock.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Architecture, stack, and milestone status
